name: NBQX
summary: NBQX (2,3-dioxo-6-nitro-7-sulfamoyl-benzo[f]quinoxaline) is an antagonist of the AMPA receptor.

pharmacology.text: NBQX (2,3-dioxo-6-nitro-7-sulfamoyl-benzo[f]quinoxaline) is an antagonist of the AMPA receptor. NBQX blocks AMPA receptors in micromolar concentrations (~10–20 μM) and also blocks kainate receptors.

uses.text: In experiments, it is used to counter glutamate excitotoxicity.
